verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source framework with a hosted cloud and CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking collection and no opt-out mechanism. The built-in pipeline metrics (docs-5) measure the developer's own bot performance and are an adjacent feature, not a vendor-telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
